evidence.mcp: Official TraderNet/Freedom MCP endpoint https://tradernet.com/mcp/tn provides about 61 tools including quotes, portfolio, orders, news, alerts, analytics and tariffs.
evidence.scheduler: Streamable HTTP with HMAC API key/secret; official integration examples smoke-test reference_get_market_status, quotes_get for AAPL.US and portfolio_get.
evidence.us_equity: Official MCP examples explicitly query AAPL.US.
evidence.account_read: portfolio_get is available via HMAC, giving potential read-only account capability.
evidence.utp_vendor: Freedom Finance Europe official 2026 General Terms state it is an official vendor under the UTP Plan Subscriber Agreement and official Nasdaq market-data distributor.
evidence.entitlement: Official 2026 terms state default Level 1 market data is 15-minute delayed; real-time Level 1 is provided only by request and is charged under the fee schedule, with account funds required to pay the fee.
evidence.turkey_local: Freedom Yatırım received Türkiye brokerage operating license in August 2026 but official company statements say it is still preparing and testing before commencing operations.

reopen_condition: Reopen only after Freedom Yatırım starts Türkiye operations and publishes a permanent-$0 scheduler-callable U.S. consolidated NBBO+last-trade entitlement with independent event timestamps and read-only account access.
